# Investigation Project Designer Brief

## Purpose

Complete this document before instructing the curriculum LLM to create a new Investigation project package.

This Markdown document acts as the **human authoring interface**.

The curriculum designer does not need to manually build JSON.

The LLM will convert this completed brief into a validated Investigation project package using the registered template capabilities.

---

# Instructions

- Complete every relevant section.
- Write `N/A` when a feature is not needed.
- Do not delete headings.
- Be specific about required curriculum and student behavior.
- Separate student-visible information from teacher-only information.
- Do not invent software implementation instructions unless truly necessary.
- Describe the learning experience you want.
- If you do not know a technical setting, describe the desired student/teacher behavior in plain language.
